I've noted it and replied to Pree in her #central-team thread: the signed order form deadline at Tansley Parcel is 25 August.

I also asked her which year she means. Today is 14 October 2026, so if she meant this year, the deadline has already passed. It could be 25 August 2027, or she may be recording a past deadline.

I found nothing that confirms or contradicts the date. The brain's search ran on keywords only, so that check was limited, and the shared folder I looked in for Tansley Parcel files was empty.
